# AGENTS.md

This file routes an AI coding agent to what it should read. It states no
rule of its own.

This repository builds its owner's portfolio site, from the template
portfolio-gallery, and publishes it with GitHub Pages. You are helping
its owner. Read [README.md](README.md) first: its prompt for an AI
assistant, under
[Ask an AI assistant to help](README.md#ask-an-ai-assistant-to-help),
says how the content, the CV it is traced to, the design, publishing and
a failed build work, and how to behave. Follow that prompt as if the
owner had given it to you. If the README no longer holds it, the same is
in [docs/how-to/use-this-template.md](docs/how-to/use-this-template.md)
and [docs/reference/content.md](docs/reference/content.md).
